messages:
Alex (PM): quick design check — I pushed the latest mock for the autoscale form to Figma: https://figma.com/file/xyz. Two quick problems I want eyes on: default pool selection for new orgs, and the SLO slider tooltip language.
Jordan (Designer): saw it, looks cleaner. question: for default pool, should we auto-select 'Hosted - shared' or leave it blank so users choose? blank feels safer but increases steps.
Priya (Eng): from infra side auto-selecting 'Hosted' simplifies onboarding (no failed deploys because no pool selected). But we need a clear affordance to switch to Dedicated.
Alex (PM): agree — suggestion: default to Hosted with a tiny badge "recommended" and a small discloser: "Change to Dedicated for reserved capacity." Thoughts on copy?
Jordan (Designer): proposed microcopy: default label: "Hosted (recommended)" and the helper: "Runs on shared capacity — lower cost, instant scale. Choose Dedicated for guaranteed throughput."
Sam (Accessibility): small a11y nits: 1) contrast for the "recommended" badge is too low on light theme; 2) the SLO slider tooltip is keyboard-inaccessible — can't reach tooltip content via focus.
Marta (Product Ops): users keep asking what SLO actually controls. The current tooltip is "Target latency SLO." That's not helpful. We should explain what happens when you move the slider (autoscale more aggressively vs save cost).
Alex (PM): yes — need an action-oriented tooltip. Draft suggestion: "SLO target: the percent of requests served within your latency goal. Slide right to prioritize lower latency (higher cost); slide left to prioritize lower cost (possible higher tail latency)." Is that too wordy?
Jordan (Designer): shorter option: "SLO: trade latency for cost. Right = lower latency (more capacity). Left = lower cost (less capacity)." Add a "Learn more" link to docs for details.
Priya (Eng): implementation note: the slider UI currently shows values 0-100. We should show a compact label like "p95 target" near the knob, not just the % number. Also we can surface current projected QPS at the chosen SLO as a tiny tag. That helps make the tradeoff tangible.
Sam (Accessibility): ensure the p95 label is text, not an icon-only element. For keyboard we need: focus on slider -> left/right arrow adjusts -> alt+Enter opens the tooltip panel with full explanation and link.
Jordan (Designer): good call. I'll add an explicit focus state and an inline "?" button next to the slider that opens a persistent panel (accessible).
Marta (Product Ops): one more: burst picker. People confuse "burst" with temporary pool increase vs. permanent capacity. Can we change label to "Burst (temporary)" and the helper: "Adds short-term GPUs when demand spikes. Costs billed separately."
Alex (PM): yes, rename and callout duration. Also edge-case: orgs with zero Dedicated pools — the pool dropdown currently shows an empty state that looks broken. We should show a CTA: "Start with Hosted" and a secondary action "Create Dedicated pool" which opens the create flow.
Priya (Eng): I'll make the dropdown render a single selectable row for Hosted when no pools exist and add the CTA link. Also add telemetry event when user switches to create Dedicated from this flow.
Jordan (Designer): microcopy proposals compiled: 1) Dropdown empty state title: "No pools configured" body: "Use Hosted for instant scale or create a Dedicated pool for reserved capacity." Buttons: "Use Hosted" / "Create Dedicated". 2) SLO tooltip short: "SLO: priority between latency and cost. Move to adjust." 3) Burst label: "Burst (temporary)" with duration selector.
Sam (Accessibility): confirm color contrast for the "recommended" badge >= 4.5:1 and ensure focus ring is visible for keyboard nav. Also ensure modal that opens from "Create Dedicated" is announced by the screen reader (role=dialog + aria-labelledby).
Marta (Product Ops): can we add a tiny CTA link in the tooltip: "See cost estimates" linking to the cost preview panel? People always want to sanity check cost impact before changing SLO.
Alex (PM): yes — add "See cost estimates" which opens the side panel. Jordan, include that in the mock. Priya, add an API hook so the side panel can render projected cost numbers for slider positions.
Priya (Eng): got it. I'll add endpoint /v1/estimate/slo?org_id=... that returns projected cost strings. For the UI we'll display the text only (no heavy charts) so perf is OK.
Jordan (Designer): I'll iterate the mock and post new frames by EOD. Quick question: what about mobile? Slider is awkward on narrow screens. Option: show a compact select with presets (Conserve / Balanced / Performance).
Alex (PM): presets are a good fallback — let's default to Balanced on mobile. We'll surface full slider on larger viewports.
Marta (Product Ops): can we add copy for those presets: Conserve = "Lower cost, higher tail latency" Balanced = "Good tradeoff" Performance = "Lowest latency, higher cost". Keep it short.
Alex (PM): perfect. Thanks team — Jordan, drop the updated Figma link here once done and tag me. We'll run a quick accessibility pass with Sam once mocks are updated.
deploy-bot: design-preview deployed to staging: https://staging.redwood.ai/console/autoscale-form — comment if anything breaks.
Alex (PM): noted — will review staging after Jordan updates. :raised_hands:
